proposedOperatorData.name: Preseli Venture
proposedOperatorData.tagline: Eco-conscious coasteering, kayaking and surfing on the North Pembrokeshire coast
proposedOperatorData.description:
Preseli Venture is an adventure activity centre and self-catering accommodation business based at Parcynole Fach, near Mathry on the North Pembrokeshire coast, a short drive from St Davids and a 20-minute walk from Abermawr beach and the Pembrokeshire Coast Path. It offers coasteering, sea kayaking, surfing, SUP boarding, rock climbing, canoeing, wild swimming, boat trips (including to Ramsey Island), beach sauna sessions, e-mountain biking and guided coastal explorer days, run in small groups by local instructors.

The business also operates on-site accommodation, including the Eco Barn (sleeps 8), Loom Cottage (sleeps 2, wheelchair-accessible) and Penbwchdy Cottage (sleeps 8), and promotes low-carbon, solar-powered operations. It is dog-friendly and open year-round.

All activity is based in North Pembrokeshire; it has no operations in Brecon Beacons, Gower, Anglesey, Llyn Peninsula, South Wales, or Mid Wales.
proposedOperatorData.uniqueSellingPoint: Long-established (decades-old), sustainability-focused adventure centre with its own eco-accommodation directly on the North Pembrokeshire coast.
